title: KaribuEHR training
subtitle: Self-guided practice on real EHR screens — no trainer required.

modules.title: Register a patient
modules.subtitle: Search, register, and start today's visit
modules.coach_intro: Practice the front desk flow: search first, register only when needed, then start today's visit.

modules.title: Record vitals
modules.subtitle: Capture vitals on the visit screen
modules.coach_intro: Learn where nurses enter vitals on the visit before the clinician documents.

modules.title: Document the visit
modules.subtitle: Clinical note, lab orders, and pharmacy
modules.coach_intro: The Clinical Officer documents, orders labs, and sends to pharmacy while the note is still open.

modules.title: Record a lab result
modules.subtitle: Lab Today queue
modules.coach_intro: Start tests, enter results, and save them to the visit chart.

modules.title: Dispense medicines
modules.subtitle: Pharmacy dispensing queue
modules.coach_intro: Pharmacy opens when the clinician sends an order — not when the note is signed.

modules.title: Record a payment
modules.subtitle: Billing without blocking care
modules.coach_intro: Payment is separate from signing the note. Record cash or mobile money when the clinic collects.
